The final proposed recovery strategy to use Yelp or direct contact (steps 107, 109, 111) was a good pivot, but the execution was cut short by an external error. While loops were identified, the recovery was often slow or involved repeating similar, ineffective actions before a more decisive change in strategy was adopted.
